measurement.field: Collect LCP, INP, and CLS from real deployed HTTPS sessions, grouped by renderer, browser, device class, and release. A local browser run is not field evidence.
measurement.lab: Run the Flutter benchmark and performance contract suites in profile-like isolation, build the release catalog, record uncompressed artifacts, then use browser performance entries for a smoke receipt. Repeat physical-device frame profiling separately before a stable release.
limitations: Dart VM unit timing is a regression alarm, not a phone GPU frame-time claim.
Browser smoke testing cannot qualify iOS, Android, VoiceOver, TalkBack, thermal throttling, or low-memory behavior.
Core Web Vitals need production RUM volume before pass or fail can be declared.

actions.action: Keep one parked scheduler for all membrane surfaces and cancel shared loading callbacks when the final listener leaves.
Keep physics updates on preallocated typed buffers and painting on one reusable path without saveLayer, blur, or per-frame child rebuilds.
Track release JavaScript, bundled variable fonts, and renderer Wasm independently so a framework runtime change is not misdiagnosed as application-code growth.
actions.verification: flutter build web --release in apps/catalog, followed by artifact-size receipt

actions.action: Capture production Core Web Vitals and renderer/device segmentation before claiming web performance readiness.
actions.verification: RUM dashboard with p75 LCP, INP, and CLS after representative traffic

actions.action: Profile raster and UI frame times on representative low-tier Android and supported iPhone hardware before stable release.
actions.verification: Flutter DevTools profile traces with zero build/raster frames over the device-specific frame budget during the interaction matrix

skill_log.applied_to: Jelly UI core and release web catalog
skill_log.principle: No performance win is claimed without a named measurement and evidence boundary.
